description: Covers the researcher-facing open science workflow: setting up OSF projects that link materials, data, code and registrations, preregistering studies and analysis plans, depositing preprints and linking them to published versions, participating in open peer review, and choosing openness levels honestly. Use when the user mentions open science, OSF, preregistration, registered reports or preprints, wants their research process (not just the software) open, asks where to preregister or preprint, or when a project's openness claims should become verifiable practice.
